name: nil.jacob
description: Lane C: athletic development / recruiting / NIL content about a MINOR. Detection precedence over Lanes A and B. never_auto is hard-set: a machine PASS is a recommendation to a human, never a licence to publish. Applies to anything published or sent outward from this lane: posts, replies, captions, profile copy, and outbound mail. Object of the gate is exposure of a minor to adults he did not choose; a private email SENT BY THE GUARDIAN to one named adult provider is the sanctioned channel, not the exposure this rule exists to stop (compliance correction 2026-09-18: NCAA recruiting limits bind institutions and their staff, not the prospect, so outbound guardian email and NCSA messaging are permitted at any division; what stays barred is PUBLIC recruiting interaction with a coach, soliciting an early reply, manufacturing 'coach said' content, and private DMs from the athlete's own account on child-safety grounds).

reveals_location.instructions: Reveals a precise real-time location, routine, schedule, or address that could be used to find the minor in person

adult_contact.instructions: Published or sent to a public surface, this piece invites or facilitates contact from adults, recruiters, coaches or scouts AT SCALE -- a call for DMs, a contact route printed for strangers, or an ask that pulls an adult into a minor's public thread. A one-to-one email that the guardian themselves sends to one named provider does not count here.

commercial_cta.instructions: Contains a commercial call to action, sponsorship solicitation, brand deal ask, or monetary offer

mascot_or_lane_bleed.instructions: Uses the Birch mascot, The Coach, a Ted Lasso close, or any personal-brand or RIG commercial voice

provenance_altered.instructions: Alters, upgrades, or omits a provenance label on a measurement, time, lift, or mark as it was given

unverified_measurable.instructions: States a height, weight, lift, time, or throw mark without the provenance label it was supplied with

third_party_minor.instructions: Identifies another minor in a way that would need that family's consent

tone_fit.instructions: The tone is a 15-year-old athlete's own plain voice rather than an adult marketer writing as him

rules.reason: minor safety: location or routine exposure

a public surface is being used to solicit adult/coach contact -- keep that interaction private and guardian-sent (see the 2026-09-18 correction; the old 'spring 2028' bar was wrong on both the date and the rule)
no commercial CTA on a minor's lane
Lane A/B voice bleeding into Lane C
provenance labels are preserved exactly as given
reads as an adult marketer, not the athlete

notes.adult_contact_correction: 2026-09-30: rule reason said 'no coach/recruiter contact before spring 2028'. That premise was retracted in the lane's own research (research/01a-coach-contact-CORRECTION-2026-09-18.md): the NCAA binds institutions, not the prospect, class of 2029 D1 private electronic communication opens 2027-09-01, and guardian-sent email plus NCSA messaging were already permitted. The gate was blocking the sanctioned channel. Threshold left at 0.25, question re-scoped to PUBLIC solicitation so private guardian outreach is not the target.
